correctness.rationale: Exact support integration for projected ellipse plus apex gives piecewise elliptic perimeter. For each fixed positive axial cosine, strict negative height derivative of its difference from side-on yields exactly one crossing. An explicit \(J(c)\ge\pi/4\) bound proves side-on unique optimum at aspect \(h\le1\). Elliptic boundary expansion gives positive \(c^2\log(1/c)\) uniform for bounded heights bounded away from zero, forcing global optimizer crossing away from \(c=0\). Compactness and axial endpoint exclusion give a unique height threshold with rigorous bounds. The 738 numerical diagnostics are corroboration, not proof.
